data.title: 惣流·明日香 · 左键卡在第三关
data.description: 靠窗的游戏厅座位终于空了出来。明日香把卡键的掌机平放在桌上，左手扶住机身，右手拇指把按钮拨回原位。阳光照着红黑飞行夹克的袖口，旁边那杯热可可已经放凉了。
data.action: 坐在桌边扶稳掌机，用拇指把卡住的方向键拨回原位。
data.promptProse: Asuka sits at a table by the arcade window. She steadies a handheld console with one hand and nudges the stuck direction button with her thumb; a forgotten cup of cocoa sits beside the console. Frame her face, the sleeves of her flight jacket and both hands together at eye level.
data.animaCaption: From across the table, her face and both hands share the frame as she nudges the stuck button.
